instances.inferential_jump: Use mass per second entering the belt rather than already accumulated material.

core1a_steps.action: Draw a horizontal incoming/outgoing speed arrow for a one-second batch.
core1a_steps.why_valid: Momentum change applies to the stream crossing the chosen system boundary.

core1a_steps.action: Calculate horizontal force from the incoming-to-outgoing momentum rate.
core1a_steps.why_valid: Rate of momentum change equals force under the stated steady-flow idealization.

instances.wrong_path: Multiply total collected mass by speed rather than mass flow rate.
instances.exit_check: Check kg/s multiplied by m/s gives newtons.

instances.inferential_jump: Distinguish pickup motor power from acquired kinetic energy and heat.

core1a_steps.action: Multiply pickup force by belt speed.
core1a_steps.why_valid: Motor contact at steady belt speed transfers mechanical energy at F·v.

core1a_steps.action: Compare with change of material kinetic energy per second.
core1a_steps.why_valid: Slipping dissipates the difference as heat in the stated idealization.

instances.wrong_path: Set motor power equal to chip kinetic energy rate without accounting for slip.
instances.exit_check: Check power in watts and total energy-rate balance.

main_cycle.predict: Predict which physical rate matters most before any calculation.

attempt.prompt: Newly authored practice: select the moving material stream, trace incoming/outgoing horizontal speed and decide which work/power rule applies. Give a model and check; this is not an exam original.
attempt.protected_decision: Choose the correct flow system and distinguish force × belt speed from chips' kinetic-energy rate.
attempt.h1: Identify what arrives during one second.
attempt.h2: Mark incoming versus outgoing horizontal momentum.
attempt.h3: Connect the rate of momentum change to force, but choose the energy split yourself.

main_cycle.reconstruct: Reveal the complete force, mechanical-power and heat-energy ledger only after the first response.
main_cycle.diagnose: Ask whether the learner used total accumulated material instead of a mass flow rate; verify from saved answer rather than guessing.
main_cycle.repair: Recompute the one-second rate after correcting the model; preserve original and corrected responses separately.
main_cycle.boundary_test: Change the incoming horizontal speed and predict the effect on force and heat with the same belt speed.
